, in addition to the ERSE and the mUPR, ASNS contains two novel mammalian UPR elements, NSRE-1 [5′-TACAT-3′] and NSRE-1 (5′-TATAT-3′).
The main takeaway from our work is that
the UPR and AAR pathways are not additive in the activation of the ASNS gene.
ASNS is an ER stress-responsive gene that is activated by UPR and AAR signalling, but not by ATF6 or XBP1 signalling.
